title: Nasdaq Wiped All 2026 Gains This Week. India Hit a 9-Month High. Here's Why.
description:
Nasdaq dropped 5.5% this week — erasing every gain made in 2026. Meanwhile, India's Nifty 50 hit 25,387, a 9-month high. This is what market decoupling actually looks like, and what it means for Indian investors.

📊 This Week's Numbers:
• Nasdaq: -5.5% (worst week of 2026)
• S&P 500: -3.7%
• Nifty 50: +2.6% → 25,387 (9-month high)
• Sensex: 82,532
• Bank Nifty: All-time record high
